title: Is Grokipedia Right-Leaning? Comparing Political Framing in Wikipedia and Grokipedia on Controversial Topics

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing semantic similarity using GPT-5 embeddings and cosine similarity, classifying sentence-level political stance (left- vs. right-leaning) using a fine-tuned RoBERTa model, and measuring the prioritization of politically aligned content at the top of web pages using the Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (nDCG) metric.
